summary: The proposal needs stronger contracts at the planner, submission, persistence, and protocol boundaries. The largest risks are dynamic dependency handling, typed voice envelopes, audio-session durability, and preserving existing sink/event behavior while keeping optional dependencies optional.

suggestions.title: Make the planner recompute from RuleResolution
suggestions.rationale: `renderers/audio.py` currently builds a static list from `form.iter_all_fields()` and copies static `required` flags, while `services/validators.py` and `services/rule_evaluator.py` resolve visibility, required state, computed values, and cleared fields dynamically. The planner should consume the same resolution result after each accepted answer, remove cleared answers, and never truncate required visible fields. Also specify subsection dependency behavior: `FormSubsection.depends_on` exists in `core/schema.py`, but `RuleEvaluator._apply_section_visibility()` only gates sections.

suggestions.title: Split submission into prepare and commit phases
suggestions.rationale: Audio currently marks the session complete and directly stores a `FormSubmission` in `api/audio_ws.py`, whereas HTTP submission performs lifecycle events, validation, metadata handling, sink writes, forwarding, and partial cleanup in `api/handlers.py`. A checker invoked only inside a final `submit()` cannot support audio re-asks before persistence. Define a pure prepare result containing final sanitized data, plausibility, and audit state, then let audio re-ask or review before an idempotent commit phase.

suggestions.title: Preserve the existing voice envelope and add a typed evidence layer
suggestions.rationale: `VoiceAnswerEnvelope` is currently strict, text-only, and opt-in through `answer_envelope`; validator support is limited to TEXT/TEXT_AREA. The proposed envelope for every spoken answer would otherwise make NUMBER, BOOLEAN, SELECT, and MULTI_SELECT values fail type coercion. Keep the existing envelope wire contract for compatibility, introduce a separate evidence envelope with `answer: Any`, and unwrap before deterministic validation then rewrap sanitized output. `AudioAnswer.value` also needs to stop being `str`-only.

suggestions.title: Make option matching produce canonical field values
suggestions.rationale: The current audio handler stores multi-select selections as a comma-joined string, while `FormValidator` canonicalizes MULTI_SELECT to a list. It also exposes disabled options from `FieldOption` as selectable values because audio rendering drops the `disabled` flag. `OptionMatcher` should match only enabled options, return the option value or list of values in schema-native shape, and reject ambiguous label/ordinal matches rather than guessing.

suggestions.title: Expose a public, typed audio snapshot store
suggestions.rationale: `PartialSaveStore` stores field answers keyed by field UID, keeps Redis in a private attribute, and returns no readable in-process state when Redis is unavailable. It is not a safe contract for serializing `AudioSessionState`, manifest bytes, pending turns, tenant binding, or optimistic resume revisions. Add a dedicated public snapshot interface or extend `PartialSaveStore` with typed namespaced snapshots; persist only durable answer evidence and cursor state, with tenant/user/form/version validation and compare-and-set semantics.

suggestions.title: Define an explicit legacy protocol adapter before enforcing extra=forbid
suggestions.rationale: The current WebSocket path accepts raw dictionaries, ignores unknown configuration keys, and uses a first-message authentication fallback. Replacing it directly with strict discriminated Pydantic events can break v1 clients. Default to a legacy protocol mode, negotiate v2 before accepting v2-only prefetch fields, and add message/turn IDs plus duplicate handling so retries and reconnects cannot apply an answer twice.

suggestions.title: Bound prefetch to the resolved plan and cache identity
suggestions.rationale: The existing pre-synthesis loop processes every static question sequentially, narrates only `q.label`, embeds base64 without a MIME field, and cannot account for answers changing dependency visibility. Prefetch only the current and bounded next resolved questions, include option/hint narration in the synthesis input, and key the cache by form UID/version, locale, voice, protocol, and narration-template revision. Do not advertise or send prefetched segments until v2 negotiation succeeds.

suggestions.title: Centralize sensitive-content and recording lifecycle policy
suggestions.rationale: Sensitivity is currently derived only from `PASSWORD` in the audio renderer, while `_finish_session()` includes every answer in `form_complete` and `_handle_answer_audio()` retains the real transcript server-side. Define one policy used by narration, UI payloads, logs, plausibility input, persistence, and review messages. Recording uploads also need answer-version IDs, size/time limits, deletion on re-record or failed commit, and cleanup after successful persistence; `AbstractBlobStorage.put()` requires full metadata including form and field UIDs.

suggestions.title: Treat hint and LLM validation as schema-wide contracts
suggestions.rationale: `FormField` is `extra="forbid"`, while `FormSchema` currently has no explicit extra policy. Adding fields requires round-trip coverage through form creation/editing/YAML extraction and every renderer. Existing HTML5, JSON Schema, and A2UI renderers explicitly emit description/placeholder metadata but have no hint contract; define precedence and wire `hint` consistently, including an A2UI extension, instead of relying on `meta["voice"]` parsing alone.

suggestions.title: Specify tabular storage for voice evidence before adding migrations
suggestions.rationale: Generic `FormSubmissionStorage` stores `data` as JSONB, but `flatten_submission()` emits each field as a column and `PostgresTableSink` defaults most field types, including text fields, to TEXT. A dict-valued voice envelope will not have a defined insert type in that path. Choose one canonical tabular representation—JSONB evidence column, scalar transcript plus evidence columns, or nested data—and test additive DDL, existing-column compatibility, and legacy normalization for both generic and per-form sinks.

suggestions.title: Complete dependency injection at the audio route boundary
suggestions.rationale: `setup_form_api()` receives `client`, `forwarder`, `blob_storage`, and `partial_store`, but the current audio handler is constructed with only registry, voice services, validator, token validator, and submission storage. The proposed shared pipeline, recording persistence, resume, and plausibility checker cannot work until those dependencies—and the authenticated tenant/request context—are explicitly passed to the adapter or a shared application service. Keep LLM imports behind the optional extra; `parrot-formdesigner` currently declares `ai-parrot` only optionally.

suggestions.title: Build parity tests around the shared commit contract
suggestions.rationale: Existing audio tests cover WebSocket navigation and mocked transcription, but the integration fixtures do not exercise submission storage, lifecycle events, forwarders, per-form sinks, partial cleanup, tenant isolation, or persisted recordings. Add the same prepared submission fixture through HTTP and audio, then assert identical sanitized data, envelope shape, plausibility audit marks, sink payload, event order, forward result, and cleanup behavior, plus adversarial tests for hidden/required fields, disabled options, reconnect duplicates, sensitive answers, and legacy protocol clients.
